subject: Post-call: FinEdge hosting paths and EU strict residency — proposed pilot
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finedge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 14:18:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot for EU-strict residency needs

Hi Oliver / Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- FinEdge requirement: EU-resident processing for all EU customer data (no US or third-country persistence).
- Primary preference: fully isolated tenant in EU (Dedicated capacity or Private VPC).
- Acceptable fallback: Hosted API strictly in EU region only (no cross-region replication), with contractual data processing guarantees.
- Secondary constraint: low-latency inference for EU customers (p50 target < 150ms for our typical prompt mix).

Attaching a short brief that compares the three hosting paths and a proposed runbook for a 6-week pilot. High-level recommendation from our side: pilot on Dedicated capacity in the EU region to validate latency, routing controls, and logging; if timeline/cost prevents Dedicated initially, we can run a Hosted EU-only pilot with strict routing and contractual terms while preparing a Dedicated onboarding.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) You confirm whether FinEdge needs infrastructure to be physically on-prem (air-gapped) for any subset of data — that will push us to the Private on-prem option.
2) Laura to run a technical deep-dive on network requirements and latency targets (she can do a short call Wed/Thu).
3) Marcus to follow with ballpark PM/month and a three-month pilot estimate for EU Dedicated vs Hosted EU.
4) Sophie to share any compliance must-haves (DPA clauses, encryption KMS preferences, SOC2 evidence).

Attachments: Redwood_Hosting_Options_Brief.pdf (pdf), FinEdge_Pilot_Runbook.xlsx (xlsx)

If that looks good I can schedule the technical deep-dive.

Best,
Rachel

Thanks Rachel — this is really helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- FinEdge cannot have any customer PII leave the EU for processing or storage. That rules out US-region fallbacks unless they are strictly ephemeral and not persisted.
- We prefer Dedicated capacity in EU if possible, but budget approval will lag; we want to explore Hosted EU-only as a pragmatic first step if you can contractually guarantee no cross-region backups and provide exported logs within the EU.
- We have an internal compliance checklist — Sophie will add the specific DPA clauses.
- For the pilot, please include expected token cost ranges and a short note on KV cache behavior for repeat queries (we have heavy repetition in A/B tests).

Availability for the technical deep-dive: Wed 10–12 CET or Thu 09–11 CET.

Hi all —

Quick technical notes ahead of the deep-dive:

1) Hosted EU-only: we can guarantee serving and storage stay within EU regions (data plane + logs) by deploying to our EU tenancy and enabling EU-only routing policies. Important caveat: some underlying control-plane metadata (non-PII telemetry) may traverse our control plane; we can add contractual controls or a private control plane (Private) for full separation.

2) Dedicated capacity (EU): gives you tenant-level isolation, predictable throughput, and we can place KV caches and model artifacts in your VPC if you choose Private networking.

3) On-prem / Private: supports air-gapped installs, HSM/KMS integration, and full control over telemetry. On-prem timelines are longer and typically require a 4–8 week ops window plus network prep.

4) Regarding KV cache and repeat queries: Dedicated and Private modes allow cache residency in EU only and you can tune TTL and sharding. Hosted EU also supports prefix caching but with operationally-managed cache nodes — we will share expected hit-rate assumptions for typical A/B test traffic in the pilot doc.

For the Wed/Thu slots, I can do Wed 10:30–11:30 CET. I'll prepare a short checklist we can run through: expected qps, max prompt length, SLOs, CIDR allowlist, KMS preferences.

Laura
